title: Caro-Kann Defense: Advance Variation
line: White's pawn pushes past; Black's bishop comes out first, then a pawn hits the base of the chain.

steps.text: Here White's pawn pushes past and takes space.
Bring the bishop out to f5 before the pawns close it in.

also.c6c5: That is also played. This lesson brings the bishop out first.

steps.text: Push the pawn on e7 one square. Now your other bishop can come out.
Push the pawn on c6 one more square. It hits the base of White's chain, the pawn on d4.
Bring the queen to b6. She adds an attacker on d4 and eyes the pawn on b2.
Bring the knight out. It is one more attacker on d4.
steps.after: Your pawn, queen and knight all hit the pawn on d4, the base of White's chain.

summary: In the Advance, the bishop comes out before the pawns close it in, then Black piles up on the base of White's chain.
